verdict.rationale: Tavily is API-first. Every core capability (search, extract, crawl, map, research, including research status and streaming) is a documented API endpoint, and account-side views such as usage details and per-request logs are also exposed through the API. However, nothing documents parity for other dashboard or UI functions such as creating or revoking API keys, billing, or project management, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API endpoints for key/billing/org management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
